resources.string: Help everyone find smoother roads. If you agree, MapMyRoad shares what it detects on your trips. You can change this at any time in Settings.

Bumps and potholes detected on your trips, and how rough each stretch of road was, with location, time, speed and vehicle type. Only trips you record from now on are shared. Trips you already recorded stay on this phone.

The first and last 500 m of every trip are removed on this phone before anything is sent, so places where your trips start and end, like home or work, are not shared. Trips shorter than about 1 km are not shared at all.
Raw sensor data, the full route of your trips, and your name, email or phone number. No account is needed.
Shared data is linked to a random ID created for this install, not to you or to your phone\'s hardware. It is used to remove duplicates, prevent abuse and delete your data.

Uploads use Wi-Fi only, unless you allow mobile data. You can stop sharing at any time, and trips you record while sharing is off are never shared. Delete my data in Privacy and data removes what was shared from this install.
Share bumps and road roughness from the trips you record from now on, to improve the community map.
Sharing bumps and road roughness. The start and end of each trip are never shared.
